content: .{@-औषधिः@} {%f.%} a herb of wonderful power. On the Himālaya there are trees of the Devadāru family which have got resinous stems. These stems burn like oil-lamps. These sticks of pinewood, therefore, are the natural lamps of the Himālaya. <ab>cf.</ab> सरलासक्तमातङ्गग्रैवेयस्फुरितत्विषः . आसन्नोषधयो नेतुर्नक्तमस्नेहदीपिकाः .. <ls>R. 4. 75</ls>; ज्वलितमहौषधिदीपिकासनाथाम् <ls>R. 9. 70</ls>.
